items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I heard the classical music, and I remember hearing Paul Whiteman, see.

ctx.x: You know? And so there again you have a discipline of music that I was hearing, which was associated with classical music, and of course my mother was appreciative of classical music. And the music that I heard on the radio naturally had to be music that was fitting -- befitting of the atmosphere in our home. It was a very serene atmosphere. So I heard the classical music, and I remember hearing Paul Whiteman, see.
